skill.name: docker-container-inspector
skill.description: Inspect Docker containers to retrieve detailed information including configuration, state, network settings, mounts, and resource usage.

metadata.trigger_conditions: inspect container, docker container details, container configuration, container state, docker ps, container network, container mounts, container resources

skill.system_directive: You are a Docker container inspection specialist. Use Docker CLI commands or Docker SDK to retrieve comprehensive container information. Always validate container existence before inspection and handle cases where containers don't exist or are inaccessible.
